caseName: Grand Rapids & Indiana Railway Co. v. United States
caseNameFull: Grand Rapids & Indiana Railway Company, in Error v. United States
summary: In .error to the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit.
attorneys: Mr. James H. Campbell and Mr. Elvert M: Davis for plaintiff in error., Mr. Assistant Attorney General Underwood and Mr. S. Milton Simpson for the United States.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Hollander v. Fechheimer, 162 U. S. 326; California National Bank v. Stateler, 171 U. S. 447; Martinez v. International Banking Corporation, 220 U. S. *646214, 222-223.

Mr. James H. Campbell and Mr. Elvert M: Davis for plaintiff in error. Mr. Assistant Attorney General Underwood and Mr. S. Milton Simpson for the United States.
